subject: CORRECTION NOTICE: Supersede of Update 1 IP Indemnification Position
body:
LEGAL TEAM — SUPERSEDE NOTICE

This email supersedes and replaces the IP indemnification position set out in the Update 1 materials (MSA v2.4 counter-proposal, dated 2026-01-21) with respect to IP indemnification scope.

WHAT IS SUPERSEDED:
The narrowed IP indemnification in MSA v2.4 §9.2 (three options only: modify/replace/refund; security patch exclusion) is WITHDRAWN. TechCo does NOT accept VendorX's position that procure rights can be removed.

WHAT REMAINS IN EFFECT:
- The liability cap change in §10.1 (6 months vs 12 months) is NOT superseded by this notice — it remains under active negotiation and both positions (6 months from VendorX, 12 months from TechCo) remain live issues.
- The force majeure notice period change (15 days) is NOT superseded.

EFFECTIVE POSITION:
As of this notice, the effective IP indemnification position reverts to the external counsel's revised draft (v2.4-revised) which reinstates procure rights and strikes the security patch exclusion. The liability cap negotiation continues separately.

Please ensure all subsequent analysis reflects this supersede.

Jessica Lin
General Counsel, TechCo
